description: The second argument of classify names a classifier of the stage. A name that no %classifier of the stage uses is an error of the document, even where a rule has that name. The loader reports it at the definition that holds the call (engine §2).
grammar:
%classifier lex
  "mi" ∈ KOhA
%rule text [word] ...
%rule word $w(W) <~w ∪ classify(phonemes($w), text)>
